title: Netflix's Qwikster Mistake: Right Strategy, Wrong Way to Do It
notes:
In 2011 Netflix knew streaming was the future. Then it hiked prices 60% and tried to split its DVD service into a new brand called Qwikster, lost 800,000 US subscribers in one quarter, and reversed course in about three weeks. What went wrong, what Netflix got right, and how to change your own business without losing the people who pay you. #business #netflix #entrepreneurship

Today's lesson: Being right about the future is not enough: don't make your customers pay for your transition.

title: Coca-Cola's New Coke Disaster: Why Taste Tests Lied in 1985
notes:
In 1985 Coca-Cola ran nearly two hundred thousand taste tests, found a formula people liked better, and replaced the most famous drink on Earth. Seventy-nine days later the original was back on shelves. Here's what the research missed, why the comeback worked, and how to change your own product without losing the customers who love it. #business #cocacola #entrepreneurship

Today's lesson: Customers don't just buy what tastes best; they buy what they feel belongs to them, so ask what they'd lose, not only what they prefer.
